name: tokenmunim
description: Cost control for AI agents: budgets as a share of your plan, a live ledger of every step, and a circuit breaker that stops loops, burn spikes and runaway usage.

taskBudget.title: Budget per task
taskBudget.description: A share of your plan, like "1% week" or "10% 5h", or dollars, like "$1". A task that uses its budget is halted. On an account without plan limits a share counts as $1.

sessionBudget.title: Session budget
sessionBudget.description: A share of your plan, like "20% week" or "50% 5h", or dollars, like "$20". Every tool call is blocked once the session has used it. Only this session's own usage counts. On an account without plan limits a share counts as $20.

loopLimit.title: Loop limit
loopLimit.description: The same failing action is blocked after failing this many times in a row.

burnLimitUsdPerMin.title: Burn limit (USD per minute)
burnLimitUsdPerMin.description: Spending faster than this over two minutes pauses the agent once with a warning.

openOnStart.title: Open the dashboard when a session starts
openOnStart.description: Off by default: TokenMunim protects every session in the background and shows nothing until you run /munim.
